definition: on a ship, train, plane or other vehicle
description: A man in a cap and dark T-shirt gets onto one vehicle after another. He climbs into a crowded minibus and squeezes past the other passengers with his bag. He steps up through the doors of a modern city bus and holds a travel card out to the card reader beside the driver. Inside, he stands in the aisle holding the rail while the bus, full of seated passengers, moves off. Then he climbs the steps of a red open-top tour bus, and sits on the top deck with both arms flung wide as the bus drives between skyscrapers.

de.answer: Er steigt in einen roten Bus ein.
de.question: Was macht der Mann?

es.answer: Está subiendo a un autobús rojo.
